create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetAssetHierarchy] ( @ID int, @Type varchar(50) ) as begin
if @Type = 'Artifact' begin with Sub as ( select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D left join Asset PA on PA.Object = 'Artifact' and PA.ObjectID = dbo.GetParentObjectID('Artifact',O.ObjectID) where O.ObjectID = @ID and O.Object = 'Artifact' union all select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ObjectID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply ( select * from Asset where Object = 'Artifact' and ObjectID = dbo.GetParentObjectID('Artifact',O.ObjectID) ) PA where O.Object = 'Artifact' ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end else if @Type in ('Taxonomy','Policy') begin with Sub as ( select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ID) P left join Asset PA on PA.ID = P.ID where O.ObjectID = @ID and O.Object = @Type union all select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ObjectID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ID) P outer apply ( select * from Asset where ID = P.ID ) PA where O.Object = @Type and (P.ID is null or (PA.ID = P.ID)) ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub end end
